event.description: Walk to Global Commons via The North Community Market, Alumni Hall, and Horizon Hall in sequence. Avoid crowds, use stairs-only routes, and minimize slippery areas. Path: Pine Ridge Apartments -> University Welcome Center -> North Laundry Facility -> The North Community Market -> North Laundry Facility -> University Welcome Center -> Grand Central Library -> Chancellor's Hall -> Alumni Hall -> Chancellor's Hall -> Grand Central Library -> Innovate Hall -> Nexus Center for AI & Robotics -> Horizon Hall -> Nexus Center for AI & Robotics -> Innovate Hall -> Grand Central Library -> Chancellor's Hall -> Global Commons.
